title: Slow calculation? useMemo, not an Effect

slides.say: Your filter is slow. Storing its result in state with an Effect is still the wrong fix.
Calculating in render is usually fine. But typing in new todo re-renders and re-runs the filter, even though todos and filter did not change.
Wrap it in use memo. React remembers the result and only re-runs it when todos or filter change.

slides.text: It runs during render, so only for pure calculations. React Compiler can do this for you.
slides.say: The function runs during rendering, so it must be pure. And React Compiler can memoize many of these automatically.
